sample_unit: CT radiology reports (subset used for evaluation after prompt tuning)

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT TNM staging from radiology reports against radiologist consensus
links.effect: Best accuracy was GPT-4 with TNM rule in the prompt: 52.2% (T), 78.9% (N), 86.7% (M); errors from numerical reasoning and anatomical or lexical knowledge gaps.
links.quote: The best accuracy scores were achieved by GPT-4 when it was presented with the TNM classification rule (52.2%, 78.9%, and 86.7% for the T, N, and M categories).

unlisted_practices: Including the TNM classification rule in the prompt to improve LLM staging accuracy
Empirical prompt optimization on a development subset

screen.practice: prompt guardrails: including TNM classification rule in prompt
screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT on clinical TNM staging from radiology reports and explicitly compares performance with vs without providing the TNM classification rule in the prompt.

primary.practice: incorporating domain rules/guidelines into the prompt
